description_en: Queries the data of a single property for a specified device or digital twin node within a specified time period
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备或数字孪生节点，在指定时间段内，单个属性的数据
name: QueryDevicePropertyData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the instance does not have an <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or </ph></props>ID, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数。数量限制：每页最多可显示50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

<notice>
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the DeviceName parameter.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。

<notice>
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device.

<notice>
 If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the ProductKey parameter.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备的名称。

<notice>
 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the property records to query. The value must be less than the value of the EndTime parameter. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的属性记录的开始时间，必须小于结束时间EndTime。取值为毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the property to query.

<props="china">
To view the property Identifier of a device, go to the Define Feature tab of the product to which the device belongs in the IoT Platform console, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html operation and view the Thing Specification Language model data in the response.
To view the property Identifier of a digital twin node, go to the Feature Properties tab of the twin node in the Digital Twin Workspace of the IoT Platform console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/278729.html.

</props>

<props="intl">To view the property Identifier of a device, go to the Define Feature tab of the product to which the device belongs in the IoT Platform console, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html operation and view the Thing Specification Language model data in the response.</props>

If the property of the device belongs to a custom (non-default) module named testFb and the property is named temperature, set the value to testFb:temperature
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的属性标识符。

<props="china">
设备的属性Identifier，可在物联网平台控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型数据中查看。
数字孪生节点的属性Identifier，可在物联网平台控制台中数字孪生工作台下的孪生节点的功能属性中查看。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/278729.html。

</props>

<props="intl">设备的属性Identifier，可在物联网平台控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型数据中查看。</props>

如果设备的属性是自定义（非默认）模块testFb下属性temperature，则参数值为testFb:temperature
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of the property records in the response. Valid values:

0: descending order.
1: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中属性记录的排序方式，取值：

0：倒序。
1：正序
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device<props="china"><ph> or digital twin node</ph></props> to which the property belongs:

<props="china">
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html operation to query the IotId of a specified device.
On the Digital Twin Details page in the IoT Platform console, click a twin node to view the Node ID.

</props>

<props="intl">You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html operation to query the IotId of a specified device.</props>

<notice>The IotId parameter is the unique identifier of the device and corresponds to the combination of the ProductKey and DeviceName parameters. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify the ProductKey and DeviceName parameters. If you specify both the IotId parameter and the combination of the ProductKey and DeviceName parameters, the IotId parameter takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询属性所属的设备ID<props="china"><ph>或数字孪生节点ID</ph></props>：

<props="china">
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html接口，可查询指定设备的**IotId**。
在物联网平台控制台的数字孪生体详情页面，单击孪生节点，可查看节点ID。

</props>

<props="intl">调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257184.html接口，可查询指定设备的**IotId**。</props>

<notice>IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time of the property records to query. The value must be greater than the value of the StartTime parameter. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的属性记录的结束时间，必须大于起始时间StartTime。取值为毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The property records of the device returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备属性记录

NextTime.description_en:
The start time of the property records on the next page.

If the property records are sorted in descending order (the Asc request parameter is set to 0), you can use this value as the EndTime request parameter when you call this operation to query the property records on the next page.
If the property records are sorted in ascending order (the Asc request parameter is set to 1), you can use this value as the StartTime request parameter when you call this operation to query the property records on the next page
NextTime.description_zh:
下一页面中的属性记录的起始时间。

当属性记录的排序方式为倒序（入参Asc为0），调用本接口查询下一页属性记录时，该值可作为下次查询的入参EndTime的值。
当属性记录的排序方式为正序（入参Asc为1），调用本接口查询下一页属性记录时，该值可作为下次查询的入参StartTime的值

NextValid.description_en:
Indicates whether the next page of property records exists. Valid values:

true: Yes. The NextTime parameter is returned. For more information, see the description of the NextTime parameter.
false: No
NextValid.description_zh:
是否有下一页属性记录。

true：有，返回NextTime。详细说明，请参见NextTime描述。
false：没有

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
